name: Reporting, Observability & Audit Log
description: Reporting and audit trail for the entire system. Provides visibility into system behavior without affecting it. Composes an append-only structured audit log (JSONL) with on-demand report generation, formatting, and webhook delivery. All types are frozen Pydantic v2 models. Enums are StrEnum. Monetary values use Decimal (serialized as string). Timestamps are UTC ISO-8601. No global state — all state flows through explicit constructor parameters and function arguments. File organization: audit_log.py (~200 lines), report_generator.py (~250 lines), __init__.py (re-exports).

types.name: EventType
types.description: Closed StrEnum of the 9 auditable system event types. Each variant's value is its snake_case name. No catch-all variant; unrecognized event strings are rejected at validation time (fail-fast).

types.name: TrendDirection
types.description: Direction of confidence score trend over recent correlation windows. StrEnum with lowercase values.

types.name: AlertSeverity
types.description: Severity level for system alerts. StrEnum with lowercase values.

types.name: AlertType
types.description: Typed category of system alert. StrEnum with snake_case values.

types.name: ReportFormat
types.description: Supported output format for report rendering. StrEnum.

types.name: DeliveryStatus
types.description: Outcome status of a webhook delivery attempt. StrEnum.

types.name: AuditEntry

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: ISO 8601 UTC datetime string of when the event occurred. Internal representation is datetime; serialized as string at the contract boundary. Defaults to current UTC time via default_factory.

validators.error_message: Timestamp must be a UTC ISO 8601 datetime string with +00:00 timezone suffix

fields.name: task_name
fields.description: Name of the task this event pertains to. Must be non-empty.

validators.error_message: task_name must be a non-empty string

fields.name: event_type
fields.description: The category of system event. Must be one of the 9 defined EventType variants.

fields.name: details
fields.description: Arbitrary key-value map of event-specific metadata. All values must be JSON-serializable (str, int, float, bool, None, list, dict). Common keys: model_used, routing_reason, confidence_score, cost, phase_from, phase_to, budget_remaining, error_message.

fields.name: correlation_id
fields.description: Optional correlation ID for tracing related events across the system. Empty string if not set. When provided, must be a non-empty string (typically UUID v4).

types.description: Immutable (frozen) Pydantic v2 BaseModel representing a single auditable system decision. ConfigDict(frozen=True). The timestamp defaults to datetime.now(UTC) via default_factory. types.name: ConfidenceDataSource
types.description: Protocol (typing.Protocol) for read-only access to the confidence engine's state. Injected into the report generator. Methods: get_task_types() -> list[str], get_confidence(task_type) -> float, get_phase(task_type) -> str, get_trend(task_type) -> TrendDirection, get_sampling_frequency(task_type) -> float, get_correlation_windows(task_type, count) -> CorrelationWindowList.

types.name: BudgetDataSource
types.description: Protocol (typing.Protocol) for read-only access to the budget manager's state. Injected into the report generator. Methods: get_total_remote_spend() -> str, get_estimated_local_savings() -> str, get_cost_per_task() -> dict[str, str], get_budget_limit() -> str, get_budget_remaining() -> str, get_budget_utilization_pct() -> float.

types.name: AuditDataSource
types.description: Protocol (typing.Protocol) for read-only access to audit log queries. Injected into the report generator. Wraps AuditLogger query methods. Methods: entries_in_range(start, end) -> AuditEntryList, entries_by_task(task_name) -> AuditEntryList, entries_by_type(event_type) -> AuditEntryList.

functions.name: JsonLinesAuditLogger.__init__
functions.description: Construct a JsonLinesAuditLogger from an AuditConfig. Validates that log_path's parent directory exists and is writable. Creates the log file if it does not exist. Configures a dedicated stdlib logging.Logger named 'apprentice.audit' with a FileHandler in append mode and a custom JSON formatter. The logger is isolated (propagate=False). Initializes an asyncio.Lock for concurrent write safety.

inputs.description: Injected audit configuration. Validated and used to set up the file handler on construction.

postconditions: A FileHandler is opened in append mode on config.log_path

functions.name: JsonLinesAuditLogger.log
functions.description: Append a single AuditEntry to the audit log. Acquires the asyncio.Lock, serializes the entry via to_json_line(), and emits it through the stdlib 'apprentice.audit' logger to the configured JSONL file handler. If the entry's event_type is not in the configured enabled_event_types filter, the entry is silently dropped. This is the only write path; all mutations go through this method. Audit write failures raise immediately — audit integrity is non-negotiable.

inputs.name: entry
inputs.description: The audit entry to append to the log.

error_cases.name: io_error
error_cases.condition: The log file has become inaccessible (e.g., disk full, file deleted, permissions changed) after initialization

error_cases.name: serialization_failure
error_cases.condition: The entry's details dict contains a non-JSON-serializable value

preconditions: entry is a valid AuditEntry instance
The JsonLinesAuditLogger has been successfully initialized (file handler is active)
postconditions: If entry.event_type is in enabled_event_types (or filter is 'all'), the JSONL file contains one additional line at the end
The new line is the JSON serialization of the entry
All previously existing lines in the file are unchanged
The entry is flushed to disk before the method returns
If entry.event_type is not in enabled_event_types, no write occurs

structured_side_effects.description: Appends one JSON line to the audit log file

functions.name: JsonLinesAuditLogger.entries_by_task
functions.description: Query the audit log for all entries matching the given task_name. Stream-reads the JSONL file line by line, deserializing each into an AuditEntry and filtering by task_name equality (case-sensitive exact match). Corrupted or unparseable lines are skipped with a warning logged to the application logger (not the audit logger). Returns entries in chronological order (file order). Read-only — never modifies the log file.

inputs.name: task_name
inputs.description: The task name to filter by (case-sensitive exact match).

functions.name: generate_report
functions.description: Generates a complete SystemReport by reading data from all three data sources (ConfidenceDataSource, BudgetDataSource, AuditDataSource). This is a synchronous, pure aggregation step with no side effects beyond reading from injected data sources. Triggered on-demand by CLI or library call. The report generator must be initialized with valid data source instances before calling this function.

inputs.description: Injected read-only interface to the confidence engine's state.

inputs.name: budget_source
inputs.description: Injected read-only interface to the budget manager's state.

inputs.name: audit_source
inputs.description: Injected read-only interface to audit log queries.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Validated report configuration controlling window count, lookback hours, etc.

structured_side_effects.description: Sends an HTTP POST request to the configured webhook URL with the JSON-serialized report

functions.name: validate_report_config
functions.description: Validates a ReportConfig instance, ensuring all fields are within their declared constraints. Called at startup to fail fast on invalid configuration. Pure function — no side effects.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: The ReportConfig instance to validate (may have invalid field values).

error_cases.name: invalid_correlation_window_count
error_cases.condition: correlation_window_count is outside [1, 1000]

error_cases.name: invalid_alerts_lookback_hours
error_cases.condition: alerts_lookback_hours is outside [1, 8760]

error_cases.name: invalid_webhook_url
error_cases.condition: webhook_url is non-empty but does not match a valid HTTP(S) URL pattern

error_data.detail: Must be a valid http:// or https:// URL, or empty string

error_cases.name: invalid_webhook_timeout
error_cases.condition: webhook_timeout_seconds is outside [1, 300]

preconditions: config is a ReportConfig instance (may have invalid field values)
postconditions: If no error is raised, the returned ReportConfig is valid and safe to use for report generation
All field-level validators have passed
If webhook_url is non-empty, it is a valid HTTP(S) URL
Returned config is the same instance or an equivalent validated copy

invariants: The audit log file is append-only: no entry, once written, is ever modified or deleted
All timestamps in audit entries and reports are timezone-aware UTC datetimes serialized as ISO-8601 strings
Every AuditEntry has a valid EventType from the closed 9-variant enum; no catch-all or unknown variant exists
The AuditEntry model is frozen (immutable) after construction
The 'apprentice.audit' logger is isolated (propagate=False) and does not emit to root or application loggers
Query methods never modify the audit log file
Corrupted lines in the JSONL file are skipped during queries with a warning — they do not cause query failures
The details dict accepts dict[str, Any] values but all values must be JSON-serializable
Config validation occurs at construction time (fail-fast), never deferred to runtime
No global state: all state is held in injected instances and explicit parameters
All public functions have full type annotations
All SystemReport instances have a unique report_id (UUID v4) and a generated_at timestamp in UTC
Report generation is read-only — it never mutates the state of any data source
All monetary/cost values are represented as string-serialized Decimals, never floating point, to preserve precision
Formatting and delivery are separate steps from generation — generate_report returns a pure data model
Webhook delivery never raises exceptions — all failure modes are captured in a DeliveryResult object
The number of TaskConfidenceReport entries in a SystemReport equals the number of task types known to the ConfidenceDataSource at generation time
Each CorrelationHistory in the report has windows_available <= windows_requested
Audit write failures raise immediately — audit integrity is non-negotiable
Files implementing this component must be under 300 lines each
